dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: This is such a great place to vacation in. Don't you think so?

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: Yes, I did. You can get to Port Ormos by traveling along the waterway.

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: I just unloaded a batch of cargo there and made a little money, so I planned to rest in Vimara Village for a while before traveling back to Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: But I realized this place is such a paradise to relax in... I really can't bear to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: I see you're of the same mind. Excellent.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you want to settle down?

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: I've been thinking about this, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: Perhaps the busy old days have made me become used to running one errand after another...

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: But I heard the villagers say that there's an old saying in Sumeru — Ingenuity leads to truth and knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Yuewen
dialogues.text: Maybe a change of mindset or lifestyle would suit me better?
